card.name: Capital I starting brand or acronym
card.fires_on: The single capital letter I when it begins a new word that is split into pieces, such as an uppercase brand name (ILEVRO, IMLYGIC, ISENTRESS) or an acronym (ICSI, IGF-1, IUS).

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: Capital I opens an all-caps drug brand name after a word like for, including or use.
modes.example: for<< I>>SENTRESS For Oral Suspension and Chewable

modes.label: Acronym or term start
modes.description: Capital I opens an acronym or a word like intravenous or itraconazole that is split into pieces.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on a capital I that starts a brand name or acronym, such as ISENTRESS or ICSI.
